evidence.observation: Monotonic pressure rise during growth at constant Ar 100 sccm: 2.999 -> 3.05 -> 3.098 -> 3.129 -> 3.152 Torr
Ar flow steady at ~100 sccm, so the rise is not a flow change
T holds 750 °C at setpoint with stable heater power ~44%
Sensor not installed; atmosphere/leak-tightness cannot be verified as the growth stage requires

args.missing_evidence: An exhaust O2 reading (or an equivalent leak check) to distinguish an air in-leak from an exhaust restriction; also a pump-down/flow-step test to see if pressure tracks Ar flow.
